title: Trajectory
description: An episode's observation/action trace, keyed by trajectory_id. The trainer joins reward records to trajectories on trajectory_id.

trajectory_id.description: Join key shared with the reward record; a string so large opaque ids never lose precision under JCS.

createdAt.description: Episode start timestamp; a string (RFC 3339 or integer nanoseconds).

index.description: Zero-based step index (≤ 2^53−1 to stay JCS-exact).

action.description: Agent action taken at this step.
